title: get_property_details request
description: Body of POST /api/v1/property-details: the get_property_details tool arguments. Non-logged-in journey, so no user, member or session fields. propertyCode or propertyName is required; every other field has a server default (application.properties, default.*). Enforced by dwl/validate-request.dwl; unknown fields are ignored.

propertyName.description: Used to look the property up when no propertyCode is given.

checkin.description: Default: today + default.checkinOffsetDays. Not in the past.

checkout.description: Default: checkin + default.nights. After checkin, at most request.maxNights nights.

currency.description: ISO 4217 preferred currency. Default: upstream currency, else default.currency.

maxPois.description: Upper bound for nearby[]; 0 skips the POI call.
